question: How many customers are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Sales.Customers

question: How many stock items are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Warehouse.StockItems

question: How many suppliers are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Purchasing.Suppliers

question: How many orders were placed in 2015?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Sales.Orders WHERE YEAR(OrderDate) = 2015

question: How many invoices were issued in 2014?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Sales.Invoices WHERE YEAR(InvoiceDate) = 2014

question: How many people in the database are employees?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Application.People WHERE IsEmployee = 1

question: How many salespeople are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Application.People WHERE IsSalesperson = 1

question: What is the name of the most expensive stock item by unit price?
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 1 StockItemName FROM Warehouse.StockItems ORDER BY UnitPrice DESC

question: What is the average unit price of all stock items, rounded to two decimals?
gold_sql: SELECT CAST(ROUND(AVG(UnitPrice), 2) AS decimal(18, 2)) FROM Warehouse.StockItems

question: How many delivery methods are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Application.DeliveryMethods

question: How many countries are in the database?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Application.Countries

question: How many states or provinces are there in total?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Application.StateProvinces

question: What is the earliest order date?
gold_sql: SELECT MIN(OrderDate) FROM Sales.Orders

question: What is the most recent order date?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(OrderDate) FROM Sales.Orders

question: How many stock items need to be kept chilled?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Warehouse.StockItems WHERE IsChillerStock = 1

question: How many colors are defined for stock items?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Warehouse.Colors

question: How many purchase orders have been placed?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Purchasing.PurchaseOrders

question: How many purchase orders are not yet finalized?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Purchasing.PurchaseOrders WHERE IsOrderFinalized = 0

question: What is the highest credit limit of any customer?
gold_sql: SELECT MAX(CreditLimit) FROM Sales.Customers

question: How many stock items have a unit price above 100?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Warehouse.StockItems WHERE UnitPrice > 100

question: Which customer category has the most customers?
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 1 cc.CustomerCategoryName FROM Sales.Customers AS c JOIN Sales.CustomerCategories AS cc ON c.CustomerCategoryID = cc.CustomerCategoryID GROUP BY cc.CustomerCategoryName ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

question: Which supplier supplies the most stock items?
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 1 s.SupplierName FROM Warehouse.StockItems AS si JOIN Purchasing.Suppliers AS s ON si.SupplierID = s.SupplierID GROUP BY s.SupplierName ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

question: Which salesperson took the most orders?
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 1 p.FullName FROM Sales.Orders AS o JOIN Application.People AS p ON o.SalespersonPersonID = p.PersonID GROUP BY p.FullName ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

question: How many customers have a delivery address in California?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Sales.Customers AS c JOIN Application.Cities AS ci ON c.DeliveryCityID = ci.CityID JOIN Application.StateProvinces AS sp ON ci.StateProvinceID = sp.StateProvinceID WHERE sp.StateProvinceName = 'California'

question: How many customers belong to the Tailspin Toys buying group?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Sales.Customers AS c JOIN Sales.BuyingGroups AS bg ON c.BuyingGroupID = bg.BuyingGroupID WHERE bg.BuyingGroupName = 'Tailspin Toys'

question: How many stock items are in the 'USB Novelties' stock group?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Warehouse.StockItemStockGroups AS sisg JOIN Warehouse.StockGroups AS sg ON sisg.StockGroupID = sg.StockGroupID WHERE sg.StockGroupName = 'USB Novelties'

question: Which delivery method is used by the most customers?
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 1 dm.DeliveryMethodName FROM Sales.Customers AS c JOIN Application.DeliveryMethods AS dm ON c.DeliveryMethodID = dm.DeliveryMethodID GROUP BY dm.DeliveryMethodName ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

question: How many orders did the customer 'Tailspin Toys (Head Office)' place?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Sales.Orders AS o JOIN Sales.Customers AS c ON o.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE c.CustomerName = 'Tailspin Toys (Head Office)'

question: What supplier category does 'Fabrikam, Inc.' belong to?
gold_sql: SELECT sc.SupplierCategoryName FROM Purchasing.Suppliers AS s JOIN Purchasing.SupplierCategories AS sc ON s.SupplierCategoryID = sc.SupplierCategoryID WHERE s.SupplierName = 'Fabrikam, Inc.'

question: Which color is assigned to the most stock items?
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 1 col.ColorName FROM Warehouse.StockItems AS si JOIN Warehouse.Colors AS col ON si.ColorID = col.ColorID GROUP BY col.ColorName ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

question: How many cities are in the state of Texas?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Application.Cities AS ci JOIN Application.StateProvinces AS sp ON ci.StateProvinceID = sp.StateProvinceID WHERE sp.StateProvinceName = 'Texas'

question: What is the quantity on hand for the stock item 'USB missile launcher (Green)'?
gold_sql: SELECT h.QuantityOnHand FROM Warehouse.StockItemHoldings AS h JOIN Warehouse.StockItems AS si ON h.StockItemID = si.StockItemID WHERE si.StockItemName = 'USB missile launcher (Green)'

question: Which stock group contains the most stock items?
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 1 sg.StockGroupName FROM Warehouse.StockItemStockGroups AS sisg JOIN Warehouse.StockGroups AS sg ON sisg.StockGroupID = sg.StockGroupID GROUP BY sg.StockGroupName ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

question: How many invoices were delivered by 'Delivery Van'?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Sales.Invoices AS i JOIN Application.DeliveryMethods AS dm ON i.DeliveryMethodID = dm.DeliveryMethodID WHERE dm.DeliveryMethodName = 'Delivery Van'

question: How many distinct customers placed orders in 2016?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID) FROM Sales.Orders WHERE YEAR(OrderDate) = 2016

question: In 2015, which month number (1 to 12) had the most orders?
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 1 MONTH(OrderDate) FROM Sales.Orders WHERE YEAR(OrderDate) = 2015 GROUP BY MONTH(OrderDate) ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

question: What is the average number of lines per order, rounded to two decimals?
gold_sql: SELECT CAST(ROUND(AVG(CAST(line_count AS decimal(18, 4))), 2) AS decimal(18, 2)) FROM (SELECT OrderID, COUNT(*) AS line_count FROM Sales.OrderLines GROUP BY OrderID) AS per_order

question: How many stock items does 'Litware, Inc.' supply?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Warehouse.StockItems AS si JOIN Purchasing.Suppliers AS s ON si.SupplierID = s.SupplierID WHERE s.SupplierName = 'Litware, Inc.'

question: What is the total quantity on hand across all stock items in the 'Clothing' stock group?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(h.QuantityOnHand) FROM Warehouse.StockItemHoldings AS h JOIN Warehouse.StockItemStockGroups AS sisg ON h.StockItemID = sisg.StockItemID JOIN Warehouse.StockGroups AS sg ON sisg.StockGroupID = sg.StockGroupID WHERE sg.StockGroupName = 'Clothing'

question: How many customers are in the Southeast sales territory?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Sales.Customers AS c JOIN Application.Cities AS ci ON c.DeliveryCityID = ci.CityID JOIN Application.StateProvinces AS sp ON ci.StateProvinceID = sp.StateProvinceID WHERE sp.SalesTerritory = 'Southeast'

question: Which stock item had the highest total quantity ordered?
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 1 si.StockItemName FROM Sales.OrderLines AS ol JOIN Warehouse.StockItems AS si ON ol.StockItemID = si.StockItemID GROUP BY si.StockItemName ORDER BY SUM(ol.Quantity) DESC

question: What were total sales excluding tax (invoice line quantity times unit price) for invoices dated in 2015, rounded to two decimals?
gold_sql: SELECT CAST(ROUND(SUM(il.Quantity * il.UnitPrice), 2) AS decimal(18, 2)) FROM Sales.InvoiceLines AS il JOIN Sales.Invoices AS i ON il.InvoiceID = i.InvoiceID WHERE YEAR(i.InvoiceDate) = 2015

question: Which sales territory had the most orders in 2016?
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 1 sp.SalesTerritory FROM Sales.Orders AS o JOIN Sales.Customers AS c ON o.CustomerID = c.CustomerID JOIN Application.Cities AS ci ON c.DeliveryCityID = ci.CityID JOIN Application.StateProvinces AS sp ON ci.StateProvinceID = sp.StateProvinceID WHERE YEAR(o.OrderDate) = 2016 GROUP BY sp.SalesTerritory ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

question: Which customer had the highest total invoiced amount (quantity times unit price) in 2015?
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 1 c.CustomerName FROM Sales.InvoiceLines AS il JOIN Sales.Invoices AS i ON il.InvoiceID = i.InvoiceID JOIN Sales.Customers AS c ON i.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE YEAR(i.InvoiceDate) = 2015 GROUP BY c.CustomerName ORDER BY SUM(il.Quantity * il.UnitPrice) DESC

question: What was the total tax amount on invoice lines for invoices dated in 2014, rounded to two decimals?
gold_sql: SELECT CAST(ROUND(SUM(il.TaxAmount), 2) AS decimal(18, 2)) FROM Sales.InvoiceLines AS il JOIN Sales.Invoices AS i ON il.InvoiceID = i.InvoiceID WHERE YEAR(i.InvoiceDate) = 2014

question: Which salesperson generated the most invoiced revenue (quantity times unit price) in 2016?
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 1 p.FullName FROM Sales.InvoiceLines AS il JOIN Sales.Invoices AS i ON il.InvoiceID = i.InvoiceID JOIN Application.People AS p ON i.SalespersonPersonID = p.PersonID WHERE YEAR(i.InvoiceDate) = 2016 GROUP BY p.FullName ORDER BY SUM(il.Quantity * il.UnitPrice) DESC

question: How many units of 'USB food flash drive - sushi roll' have been invoiced in total?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(il.Quantity) FROM Sales.InvoiceLines AS il JOIN Warehouse.StockItems AS si ON il.StockItemID = si.StockItemID WHERE si.StockItemName = 'USB food flash drive - sushi roll'

question: Which supplier's stock items generated the most invoiced revenue (quantity times unit price) across all time?
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 1 s.SupplierName FROM Sales.InvoiceLines AS il JOIN Warehouse.StockItems AS si ON il.StockItemID = si.StockItemID JOIN Purchasing.Suppliers AS s ON si.SupplierID = s.SupplierID GROUP BY s.SupplierName ORDER BY SUM(il.Quantity * il.UnitPrice) DESC

question: Which state had the highest invoiced revenue (quantity times unit price) in 2015, based on the customers' delivery city?
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 1 sp.StateProvinceName FROM Sales.InvoiceLines AS il JOIN Sales.Invoices AS i ON il.InvoiceID = i.InvoiceID JOIN Sales.Customers AS c ON i.CustomerID = c.CustomerID JOIN Application.Cities AS ci ON c.DeliveryCityID = ci.CityID JOIN Application.StateProvinces AS sp ON ci.StateProvinceID = sp.StateProvinceID WHERE YEAR(i.InvoiceDate) = 2015 GROUP BY sp.StateProvinceName ORDER BY SUM(il.Quantity * il.UnitPrice) DESC

question: How many orders placed in 2015 had more than 3 order lines?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT o.OrderID FROM Sales.Orders AS o JOIN Sales.OrderLines AS ol ON o.OrderID = ol.OrderID WHERE YEAR(o.OrderDate) = 2015 GROUP BY o.OrderID HAVING COUNT(*) > 3) AS big_orders

question: For orders placed in 2015, what was the average number of days between the order date and the expected delivery date, rounded to two decimals?
gold_sql: SELECT CAST(ROUND(AVG(CAST(DATEDIFF(day, OrderDate, ExpectedDeliveryDate) AS decimal(18, 4))), 2) AS decimal(18, 2)) FROM Sales.Orders WHERE YEAR(OrderDate) = 2015

question: Which buying group had the higher invoiced revenue (quantity times unit price) in 2015: Tailspin Toys or Wingtip Toys?
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 1 bg.BuyingGroupName FROM Sales.InvoiceLines AS il JOIN Sales.Invoices AS i ON il.InvoiceID = i.InvoiceID JOIN Sales.Customers AS c ON i.CustomerID = c.CustomerID JOIN Sales.BuyingGroups AS bg ON c.BuyingGroupID = bg.BuyingGroupID WHERE YEAR(i.InvoiceDate) = 2015 GROUP BY bg.BuyingGroupName ORDER BY SUM(il.Quantity * il.UnitPrice) DESC

question: How many customers placed no orders in May 2016?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Sales.Customers AS c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Sales.Orders AS o WHERE o.CustomerID = c.CustomerID AND o.OrderDate >= '2016-05-01' AND o.OrderDate < '2016-06-01')

question: Which stock group has the highest average unit price among its stock items?
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 1 sg.StockGroupName FROM Warehouse.StockItems AS si JOIN Warehouse.StockItemStockGroups AS sisg ON si.StockItemID = sisg.StockItemID JOIN Warehouse.StockGroups AS sg ON sisg.StockGroupID = sg.StockGroupID GROUP BY sg.StockGroupName ORDER BY AVG(si.UnitPrice) DESC

question: How many customers had invoiced revenue (quantity times unit price) above 50,000 in 2016?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT i.CustomerID FROM Sales.InvoiceLines AS il JOIN Sales.Invoices AS i ON il.InvoiceID = i.InvoiceID WHERE YEAR(i.InvoiceDate) = 2016 GROUP BY i.CustomerID HAVING SUM(il.Quantity * il.UnitPrice) > 50000) AS big_customers

question: Which salesperson had the highest average order value (order line quantity times unit price) in 2015?
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 1 p.FullName FROM (SELECT o.OrderID, o.SalespersonPersonID, SUM(ol.Quantity * ol.UnitPrice) AS order_value FROM Sales.Orders AS o JOIN Sales.OrderLines AS ol ON o.OrderID = ol.OrderID WHERE YEAR(o.OrderDate) = 2015 GROUP BY o.OrderID, o.SalespersonPersonID) AS ov JOIN Application.People AS p ON ov.SalespersonPersonID = p.PersonID GROUP BY p.FullName ORDER BY AVG(ov.order_value) DESC

question: In which year was invoiced revenue (quantity times unit price) the highest?
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 1 YEAR(i.InvoiceDate) FROM Sales.InvoiceLines AS il JOIN Sales.Invoices AS i ON il.InvoiceID = i.InvoiceID GROUP BY YEAR(i.InvoiceDate) ORDER BY SUM(il.Quantity * il.UnitPrice) DESC

question: What was the total value of purchase order lines (ordered outers times expected unit price per outer) for supplier 'Litware, Inc.', rounded to two decimals?
gold_sql: SELECT CAST(ROUND(SUM(pol.OrderedOuters * pol.ExpectedUnitPricePerOuter), 2) AS decimal(18, 2)) FROM Purchasing.PurchaseOrderLines AS pol JOIN Purchasing.PurchaseOrders AS po ON pol.PurchaseOrderID = po.PurchaseOrderID JOIN Purchasing.Suppliers AS s ON po.SupplierID = s.SupplierID WHERE s.SupplierName = 'Litware, Inc.'

question: How many different stock items did the customer 'Tailspin Toys (Head Office)' order in 2016?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ol.StockItemID) FROM Sales.OrderLines AS ol JOIN Sales.Orders AS o ON ol.OrderID = o.OrderID JOIN Sales.Customers AS c ON o.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE c.CustomerName = 'Tailspin Toys (Head Office)' AND YEAR(o.OrderDate) = 2016

question: Which customer category had the highest invoiced revenue (quantity times unit price) in 2014?
gold_sql: SELECT TOP 1 cc.CustomerCategoryName FROM Sales.InvoiceLines AS il JOIN Sales.Invoices AS i ON il.InvoiceID = i.InvoiceID JOIN Sales.Customers AS c ON i.CustomerID = c.CustomerID JOIN Sales.CustomerCategories AS cc ON c.CustomerCategoryID = cc.CustomerCategoryID WHERE YEAR(i.InvoiceDate) = 2014 GROUP BY cc.CustomerCategoryName ORDER BY SUM(il.Quantity * il.UnitPrice) DESC
